Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — W-9 and PO info for Acme Analytics

Thanks Bethany — quick follow-up. I reviewed the W-9 you sent. Before we can proceed with a PO we need to confirm two items:

1) EIN verification: Can you confirm that 12-3456789 is the company EIN (not a subsidiary or payroll EIN)? Occasionally the vendor portal pulls a parent-company EIN which requires a cross-check.
2) Legal entity type: The W-9 lists "Acme Analytics, Inc." — can you confirm corporate suffix (Inc. vs LLC) and whether invoices will be issued under that legal entity or a different payee name?

If you can send back a signed W-9 that includes the payee name exactly as it should appear on the PO/invoice, and optionally the completed vendor onboarding form (we can also create a record in our portal and send a link), we can move to PO creation.

Cc'ing Lauren from Procurement — Lauren, could you confirm standard payment terms (we typically default to Net30) and whether we need any additional supplier classification for tax (foreign-owned vs US)?

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai

Appreciate the quick reply. Apologies — the initial file was an older template. Attaching an updated signed W-9 (W-9_Acme_Signed.pdf) and a DocuSign link for our corporate affidavit (DocuSign_CorporateAffidavit_link.txt).

To confirm:
- EIN: 12-3456789 — this is the correct Employer Identification Number for Acme Analytics, Inc.
- Legal entity: Acme Analytics, Inc. (Invoices will be issued under that name)
- Billing contact for invoices: finance@acme-analytics.com

We don't need any special supplier classification — US taxable entity. Preferred payment terms are Net30 but we can accept whatever Redwood sets for new vendors.

DocuSign: https://docusign.net/AcmeCorpAffidavit/ABC123

Attachments: W-9_Acme_Signed.pdf, DocuSign_CorporateAffidavit_link.txt

Let me know if you need anything else to get the PO started.

Bethany sent the signed W-9 and DocuSign affidavit. Quick action items to unblock PO:

- Verify EIN 12-3456789 against IRS/TIN match (vendor portal snapshot linked).
- Confirm remittance address matches the W-9 and update vendor profile if needed.
- Set payment terms to Net30 and default GL code for professional services (4501).
- If legal name in system differs by suffix (Inc vs LLC) confirm the correct payee name for PO.

Attaching: vendor_profile_snapshot.png (screenshot from vendor portal)

If all checks out, please move Acme Analytics to the PO-ready queue and draft PO for $45,000 (initial quarterly engagement).

Thanks team — completed verification steps: 

- IRS TIN match returned a positive confirmation for EIN 12-3456789.
- The legal name in our vendor registry had an old suffix (Acme Analytics LLC) — vendor confirmed the correct legal name is Acme Analytics, Inc.; registry updated to match signed W-9.
- Remittance address on W-9 matches the vendor portal snapshot.
- Payment terms set to Net30; GL code 4501 applied.

I've prepared a draft PO (PO_009412_draft.pdf) for $45,000 with start date 2027-04-15. Bethany, once you confirm the billing contact and delivery instructions on the PO we can issue it and enable invoicing.

Next steps:
- Bethany: confirm billing contact and if invoices should reference a purchase order number (we recommend they include PO-009412 on each invoice).
- Procurement (Lauren/Karthik): finalize and release PO after confirmation.
